prompt: Perform exactly one build-side G2 development task: implement the minimum Cliffs interconnect provider required for the current G2 SD-only Linux DTS, then rebuild and validate the current G2 kernel/DTB candidate. First read the repository rules, roadmap, existing G2 evidence, current G2 DTS/build reports, and Cliffs source evidence. Use only source-supported Cliffs interconnect identifiers/topology such as MASTER_SDCC_2=47, SLAVE_SDCC_2=542, SLAVE_EBI1=512, MASTER_APPSS_PROC=2; do not copy SM8550/SM8650 device-specific numeric IDs. Determine the smallest upstream-Linux-7.1.5-compatible provider needed by the current G2 DTS and SDHCI node. Preserve unknown or unverified G2-specific endpoint/phandle details as explicit unresolved items instead of guessing. Use Linux revision 73e3f0710014fe6d4ed98cfc02292f6121db7558 where applicable. Re-run the provider-map validator and relevant kernel/DTB validation; record exact commands, source lineage, changed files, checksums, exact first compiler/validator errors if blocked, and the next blocker. Commit on a dedicated OpenCode branch and open a PR; do not merge. Build-side only: do not flash, boot, modify, erase, repartition, or write any G2 device, microSD card, Android/UFS/ABL/GPT/boot/vendor_boot/vbmeta/dtbo/firmware partition. Create and maintain dedicated live trace automation/status:dispatch/trace/G2-C-0002-R2.json and ensure completion is checked against both the exact Actions Job and matching trace. Do not use Codex; execution path is GitHub Actions -> OpenCode -> official DeepSeek API -> DeepSeek V4-Pro. This is a fresh rerun of G2-C-0002-R1; do not reuse R1 run, job, or trace as evidence for R2. The V4-Pro selection is specific to this provider-porting task and must not establish V4-Pro as the default model for later tasks.
